task_instructions_resume: This launcher cannot restore the task's instructions with a bare Resume. Send a continuation message or choose the original launcher. Nothing was started or sent.
skill_unavailable: This skill is unavailable or the execution environment changed. Remove it and select it again. Nothing was sent.
readonly_unsupported: Cannot apply read-only mode on this launch path. Choose a compatible terminal launcher without conflicting permission options.
launcher_kind_missing: The engine on that computer has no provider for this kind of agent, so nothing was started and nothing else runs in its place. Pick one of its providers, or turn one on in its settings.
timeout: The request timed out. The computer may be busy or the network unstable. Check whether it went through, then try again later.
unreachable: The connection to this computer dropped. Reconnect it, check whether your last action went through, then try again.
failed: The request could not be completed. Open details for the diagnostic.
input_draft: There is a draft in the terminal. Resolve it before sending.
dialog_open: The terminal is waiting for a choice. Resolve it there first.
dialog_open_notice: The terminal is showing a notice that Enter dismisses. Dismiss it there, or allow sending to dismiss it first.
not_delivered: The terminal on the computer didn’t accept this message, and nothing was typed. Try again shortly.
not_delivered_finished: This agent’s terminal has already ended, so nothing was typed. Reopen or resume it on the computer before sending again.
not_delivered_botmux_owner_unresolved: BotMux couldn’t tell who owns this bot, so it refused the message as the owner and nothing was sent. Set ownerUnionId for the bot in BotMux, or keep its allowedUsers to just you, then send again.
not_delivered_botmux_owner_mismatch: BotMux refused the message: the BotMux Owner Union ID set in Persona isn’t this bot’s owner, so nothing was sent. Check it in Settings › Agents, or clear it to send the usual way.
not_delivered_botmux_owner_refused: BotMux refused to take this message as the bot’s owner, so nothing was sent. Check the BotMux Owner Union ID in Settings › Agents, or clear it to send the usual way.
modes_partial_not_delivered: Earlier settings in this request may already have changed or been queued, but the terminal didn’t accept the remaining change. Check the current settings before trying again.
modes_partial_terminal_finished: Earlier settings in this request may already have changed or been queued, but the agent’s terminal ended before the remaining change could be sent. Check the current settings, then reopen or resume the agent before trying again.
modes_partial_dialog_open: Earlier settings in this request may already have changed or been queued, but the terminal is waiting for a choice before the remaining change can run. Check the current settings and resolve the terminal prompt first.
modes_partial_failed: Earlier settings in this request may already have changed or been queued, but a remaining change could not be completed. Check the current settings before trying again.
modes_partial_node_outdated: Earlier settings in this request may already have changed or been queued, but personad on this computer is too old for ultracode. Check the current settings and update this computer’s node before trying ultracode again.
prompt_changed: The terminal prompt has changed. Refresh before answering.
attach_busy: This session is busy in another client. Wait until it is available.
terminal_not_ready: The computer’s terminal wasn’t ready to start the agent. Nothing was sent; try again.
agy_companion_offline: Antigravity isn’t connected to Persona on this computer, so nothing was started. Reconnect it, or start agy in a terminal instead.
node_outdated: The computer’s Persona service is too old for this operation. Update it first.
in_doubt: Delivery cannot be confirmed. Check the result before sending again.
guide_retry_refused: Claude Code opened a guide dialog (“{dialog}”) while receiving this message. Persona dismissed it with Esc, but cannot confirm whether the first attempt arrived and the retry was refused ({retry_code}). Check the conversation or terminal before sending again.
offline: This computer is offline. Make sure it’s on and connected to the internet and that Persona Link is running, then try again.
nothing_queued: Nothing is queued for the agent any more.
send_now_unsupported: This agent can’t send queued messages now. They go to it in order.
queue_edit_unsupported: This agent’s queued messages can’t be changed from here. They go to it in order.
send_now_unrecognized: Persona doesn’t recognize this Claude Code’s send-now hint, so it pressed nothing. The queued messages still go in order; to send them now, use send-now in the terminal.
not_a_repository: This folder isn’t in a Git repository.
not_our_worktree: This folder isn’t a worktree Persona made.
worktree_in_use: An agent still runs in this worktree. Close it first.
worktree_unmerged: The branch has commits that aren’t on the main branch.
no_directory: Persona doesn’t know this pane’s folder.
detached_head: HEAD is detached. Switch to a branch first.
no_upstream: This branch has no upstream branch. Set one on the computer first.
uncommitted_changes: The working tree has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them on the computer, then pull.
not_fast_forward: The branch and its upstream have both moved on, so it can’t fast-forward. Merge or rebase it on the computer.
push_rejected: The remote has newer commits. Pull first, then push. Nothing was forced.
peer_unsupported: This Claude session doesn’t offer a channel Persona can use for messages (an older Claude Code, or cross-session messages are turned off there). Continue it on the computer.
peer_unreachable: Couldn’t reach this Claude session’s message channel (it may have just restarted or quit). Try again shortly, or continue it on the computer.
peer_too_long: The message is too long for the message channel. Split it into shorter messages.
peer_unconfirmed: The message was handed to this Claude session, but it hasn’t taken it yet: it may be waiting for approval on the computer, or it was dropped as a repeat. Check on the computer before sending it again.
peer_held: The message reached this Claude session, which is holding it for approval on the computer: it runs in bypass permissions mode, so it holds messages from Persona until you allow them there. No need to send it again.
peer_command: The message channel only delivers plain messages and doesn’t run slash commands. Type the command on the computer.
desktop_open_failed: Claude’s desktop app on the computer didn’t open this session in time (it may still be starting, or the computer may be locked). Open it there, then send again. Nothing was sent.
open_elsewhere_desktop: This session is open in Claude’s desktop app on the computer, and Persona won’t start a second Claude writing to it. Continue it there, or close it there and send again. Nothing was sent.
open_elsewhere_terminal: This session is open in a terminal on the computer, and Persona won’t start a second Claude writing to it. Continue it there, or close it there and send again. Nothing was sent.
open_elsewhere_program: This session is open in another program on the computer, and Persona won’t start a second Claude writing to it. Continue it there, or close it there and send again. Nothing was sent.
open_elsewhere_other: This session is open somewhere else on the computer, and Persona won’t start a second Claude writing to it. Continue it there, or close it there and send again. Nothing was sent.
open_elsewhere_agents_list: This tab is on Claude Code’s agents list. Open the terminal, pick a session with the arrow keys and press Enter, then send. Nothing was sent.
modes_on_computer: This Claude session runs in Claude on the computer (its desktop app or another terminal). Change its mode, effort or model there.
modes_not_running: This agent isn’t running. Resume it from its terminal page, then change this.
modes_unsupported: This agent runs in a terminal (Cursor CLI or Antigravity CLI): its permission mode, effort and model are set when it starts and can’t be changed from here. Start a new agent with the mode you want.
effort_change_pending: The message was not sent because the thinking effort change has not been confirmed. If the change failed, choose a thinking effort again.
modes_codex_version: This Codex session was started by a Codex older than 0.169, which can’t switch its model or thinking effort from here. Change them in its terminal.
modes_codex_no_rollout: This Codex has no session record yet (its first message starts one), so a change couldn’t be confirmed. Send it a message first, or change it in its terminal.
modes_codex_unconfirmed: The change was typed into Codex, but its session record didn’t show it in time, so it may not have taken. Check its terminal before trying again.
agent_stopped: This agent has stopped. Its conversation and terminal stay; it doesn’t take messages, and nothing was sent. To run it again, use Resume on its terminal page.
resume_not_allowed: This agent cannot be resumed automatically. Use Resume on its terminal page.
stop_not_saved: The stop state could not be saved. Nothing was started, stopped or closed; try again.
shell_waiting: The new terminal tab stopped on a question before the agent could start, so this message wasn't sent. Where Persona lists the question's answers, pick one and the message goes out once the agent is up; or answer it in the tab on the computer and start the agent again. The tab stays open for a few minutes.
start_line_rejected: The new terminal tab didn't take the start command, twice. Nothing ran; check what that shell does when it starts, then try again.
start_tab_gone: That terminal tab isn't waiting any more: it was closed after a few minutes, or an agent runs there now. Nothing was typed; start the agent again.
start_not_waiting: This agent's start isn't waiting on a question any more. Nothing was typed.
choice_not_offered: That isn't one of the answers this question offers. Nothing was typed.
secret_env_gone: The secret values approved for this start aren't on the computer any more: a start already took them, or they were approved more than two minutes ago. Nothing ran; start the agent again and approve them again.
directory_untypable: This directory’s name contains a control character, such as a tab or a line break, so the agent can’t be started in it from here. Rename the directory or choose another one.
codex_not_ready: Codex on the computer isn’t at its input box yet (still loading, or another screen is open). Nothing was sent; try again in a moment.
codex_first_text: Codex’s first message can only be text. Remove the photos or files, then send it again.
codex_first_unconfirmed: The message went into Codex, but its session didn’t appear in time. Check the computer before sending it again.
codex_compact_busy: Codex is working on a turn. Compact once it finishes; nothing was sent.
codex_waiting: Codex hasn’t had its first message yet. This works once it has its session.
codex_no_box: Codex opened in a new tab on the computer, but its input box didn’t appear within a minute.
codex_no_box_here: Codex started in the pane you picked, but its input box didn’t appear within a minute. The pane is left as it is.
codex_not_logged_in: Codex isn’t signed in on that computer, so the agent didn’t start. Run codex login in a terminal there, then start the agent again.
switch_unsupported: Only a Claude Code agent running in a terminal, on a model provider Persona can tell, can switch to another model provider. Start a new conversation to use that one.
switch_launcher_missing: That model provider isn’t set up on this computer. Pick another one.
switch_other_agent: That model provider runs another agent, not Claude Code. Start a new conversation to use it.
switch_model_locked: That model provider always runs its own model, so the one you picked wouldn’t be used. Pick it without a model, or pick another provider.
switch_config_dir: That model provider keeps Claude Code’s data and sign-in in another folder, where this conversation isn’t saved. Start a new conversation to use it.
switch_not_stopped: The agent didn’t quit, so it stays on its current model provider and the switch was dropped. Nothing was sent.
switch_failed: The agent couldn’t start on the other model provider, so it went back to the one it was on and the switch was dropped. Your message wasn’t sent.
switch_failed_stopped: The agent couldn’t start on the other model provider and has stopped; the switch was dropped. Your message wasn’t sent. Check its terminal, or use Resume on its terminal page.
switch_stale: The agent moved to another model provider since you picked this one. Look at the provider it runs on now, then pick again.
switch_pick_model: Persona can’t see which model that model provider runs by default, and without one the conversation would keep its current model. Pick a model of that provider.
switch_under_way: The agent is moving to another model provider right now. Try again once it runs; nothing was done.
switch_busy: The agent is busy right now (working, waiting for you, starting, or running something in the background), so it wasn’t moved to the other model provider. Nothing was sent; try again once it has stopped.
rewind_busy: Wait for the session to become idle before rewinding.
rewind_unsupported: This session does not support the requested rewind.
rewind_mismatch: The selected message moved. Reload the conversation before rewinding.
rewind_nothing: There is no message to rewind to.
rewind_failed: Rewind could not be confirmed. Reload the conversation to check its current history.
not_loaded: This agent isn’t running in Paseo. Its conversation loads while its chat is open.
preview_no_terminal: This computer has no terminal engine to run the server in. Turn one on in this computer’s settings, then try again.
space_gone: No engine on this computer lists this space any more. Refresh and try again.
assistant_service_tier_start_only: Fast can be chosen only when starting a new conversation. Change it in the existing conversation instead.
assistant_service_tier_unsupported: Fast from the first message is available only for Codex models that offer it. Nothing was sent.
assistant_service_tier_refused: Codex couldn’t apply Fast before the first message. Nothing was sent; try again or choose Standard.
agent_speed_unsupported: This launcher can’t start an Agent at that speed: {reason}
agent_speed_start_only: A faster speed applies only to a new Agent start: {reason}
agent_speed_tier_new: Start a new Codex Agent to choose a service tier.
agent_speed_tier_value: Choose priority or ultrafast and omit the separate speed field.
agent_speed_model: This model doesn’t advertise that Codex speed: {reason}
session_speed_unsupported: This session does not offer the selected speed.
session_speed_refused: The agent refused the speed change. Check the terminal for details.
session_speed_unconfirmed: The terminal did not confirm the speed change. Check it before trying again.
assistant_supervision_busy: This conversation's task-follow-up role changed. Wait for its current work to finish, then try again. Nothing was sent.
assistant_categories_busy: This conversation's information categories changed. Wait for its current work to finish, then try again. Nothing was sent.
assistant_supervision_runtime: This Agent cannot receive separate task follow-up instructions. Supported launchers on this computer: {launchers}. Nothing was started or sent.
assistant_supervision_none: none detected; connect or update a compatible runtime
assistant_supervision_account: This engine supports task follow-up, but this account has not enabled custom system instructions. Ask the engine provider to enable them for your account. Nothing was started or sent.
assistant_supervision_node_outdated: Update this computer's Persona Link before following up tasks here. Its current version cannot apply separate task instructions. Nothing was started or sent.
omp_options: You can choose a model only when starting a new omp session in herdr or Orca. Leave permission mode, thinking effort and ultracode unset.
omp_resume_unknown: Persona can’t find this omp session’s file, so it can’t resume it from here. Continue it on the computer with omp --resume. Nothing was sent.
resume_unknown: This computer has no record of that conversation, so it can’t be continued here. Nothing was started.
orca_resume: Orca can’t resume this Agent’s session from here. Resume it on the computer. Nothing was started or sent.
work_agent_resume: This session can’t be resumed with a launcher: pi continues in the tab it ran in, and Cursor and agy sessions are resumed on the computer. Nothing was started.
agent_not_in_front: The Agent isn’t in front in its terminal (it may be suspended), so nothing was sent. Bring it back to the front on the computer and send again.
not_running_engine: This session isn’t running (it may be suspended or have exited), and a session in {engine} has to be reopened on the computer. Nothing was sent.
held_ahead: Earlier messages to this Agent are still waiting to be sent. Send this one after them.
held_not_kept: Earlier messages are still waiting to be sent, and this one couldn't be saved. Try again in a moment.
held_full: Too many messages are waiting for this Agent. Delete some, or send this one when the computer is back.
held_start_full: Too many Agent starts are waiting for this computer. Delete some, or start this one when the computer is back.
assistant_launcher_profile_switch: Can’t switch this conversation to the selected connection. Nothing was sent. Choose the previous connection to continue here, or start a new conversation with the selected connection and one of its models.
assistant_model_unresolved: “{launcher}” has no concrete model mapped for “{model}”, so nothing was sent. Pick one of its listed models or choose its default.
codex_writer_busy: This Codex thread is already being written by another process on the computer. Nothing was sent. Continue in its original Codex window or terminal; if that process has exited, wait for it to disconnect, refresh, and try again.
turn_over_background: This turn had already ended, so nothing was interrupted. Its background work is still running; stop it in the terminal on that computer.
omp_stopped: This omp session has stopped, so this can’t be done. Send a message to continue it on the computer.
conversation_retired: This session no longer runs the conversation.
agent_assistant_workspace: Cannot start an agent in the assistant workspace. Choose the project folder or a separate worktree; no agent was started.
codex_writable_symlink: Cannot start Codex in workspace-write mode: {name} is a symlink under a writable root, so its sandbox cannot enforce the read-only path. Choose a project folder as cwd or use read-only mode. Nothing was started; the symlink was not changed.
agy_in_terminal: This Antigravity conversation is open in agy in a terminal on that computer, and Persona can’t reach that terminal. Nothing was sent. Answer in the terminal, or close agy there and try again.
effort_input_draft: The terminal’s input box has text that hasn’t been sent (“{draft}”), so the effort wasn’t changed and nothing was typed. Clear it on the computer and try again.
effort_input_draft_plain: The terminal’s input box shows text (“{draft}”), so the effort wasn’t changed and nothing was typed. This terminal is read without colors, so Claude’s grey suggested message counts as text too. Clear it on the computer and try again.
speed_input_draft: The terminal’s input box has text that hasn’t been sent (“{draft}”), so the speed wasn’t changed and nothing was typed. Clear it on the computer and try again.
speed_input_draft_plain: The terminal’s input box shows text (“{draft}”), so the speed wasn’t changed and nothing was typed. This terminal is read without colors, so Claude’s grey suggested message counts as text too. Clear it on the computer and try again.
engine_not_running: {engine} isn’t running on this computer, so nothing was started. Open {engine} on it and try again.
engine_not_installed: {engine} isn’t installed on this computer, so nothing was started. Install and open {engine} on it and try again, or choose another engine in Settings › Machines › Engine.
engine_incompatible: The version of {engine} on this computer doesn’t work with Persona, so nothing was started. Update {engine} and Persona to the latest version and try again.
orca_away: Orca isn’t running on that computer, so nothing was sent. Open Orca there and try again.
orca_refused: Orca turned this down, and nothing was changed: {detail}
orca_unknown: It’s not clear whether Orca did this. Check the chat in Orca on that computer before you try again.
orca_session_gone: This chat is no longer in Orca.
orca_closed: This chat is closed in Orca. Send it a message to open it again, then change its settings.
orca_mode_unsupported: Orca’s chats of this kind don’t take that permission mode ({detail}), so nothing was changed.
orca_rename_unsupported: This version of Orca can’t rename chats from Persona. Rename it in Orca, or update Orca.
orca_start_unsupported: This version of Orca can’t start chats from Persona, so nothing was started. Start the chat in Orca, or update Orca.
orca_start_folder: No project in Orca holds this folder, so nothing was started. Open the folder in Orca, then start the chat again.
orca_start_launcher: Orca on that computer can’t start this kind of chat ({detail}), so nothing was started. Pick another launcher.
orca_chat_runtime_missing: {program}’s chat runtime isn’t installed in Orca on that computer, so nothing was started. Start it in a terminal, or install it from a new chat tab in Orca.
orca_chat_unavailable: Orca on that computer can’t open {program} as a chat here, so nothing was started. Start it in a terminal instead.
orca_not_registered: Orca on that computer has no project open, so nothing was started. Open a project in Orca there, then start the Agent again.
orca_workspace_unavailable: The chosen Orca workspace isn’t available any more, or doesn’t hold this folder, so nothing was started. Refresh and pick the workspace again.
runtime_session: This session belongs to another app (an Orca chat, for example), so nothing was started. Continue it there.
codex_launch_preferences: Persona can’t use Orca’s Codex launch settings, so nothing was started. Open the details for why, or pick a launcher you set up in Persona.
codex_launch_preferences_unreadable: Persona couldn’t read Orca’s launch settings, so nothing was started. Update Orca, or pick a launcher you set up in Persona.
codex_launch_preferences_custom: Orca’s Codex launcher has a command or environment of its own, so nothing was started. Pick the launcher set up that way in Persona.
codex_launch_preferences_shell: Orca’s Codex launch arguments need a shell to run, so nothing was started. Pick a launcher you set up in Persona.
codex_launch_preferences_quoting: Orca’s Codex launch arguments have a quote that isn’t closed, so nothing was started. Correct them in Orca and try again.
tab_name_invalid: A tab name needs 1 to {max} characters.
tab_gone: This terminal tab has closed. Refresh and try again.
pane_gone: This terminal pane has closed. Refresh and try again.
pane_has_agent: An Agent is already running in this pane, so nothing was started.
pane_foreground_unknown: Persona can’t tell what runs in this pane, so nothing was started. Try again shortly.
pane_foreground_unreadable: Persona couldn’t read what runs in this pane, so nothing was started: {detail}
pane_not_at_prompt: {program} is running in this pane, not a shell prompt, so nothing was started.
pane_directory_unknown: Persona doesn’t know this pane’s folder, so nothing was started.
close_not_in_terminal: This Agent isn’t running in a terminal on this computer, so it can’t be closed from here.
agent_busy_terminal_changed: The stopped Agent’s terminal changed or is in use, so it wasn’t closed. Check it on the computer before closing it.
not_running_directory_gone: This session’s folder is gone, so it can’t be continued in a terminal. Nothing was sent.
not_running_resume_timeout: The session was reopened in a new tab, but it didn’t come up within {seconds} seconds. Nothing was sent.
not_running_agent_exited: This session’s Agent has exited and its terminal is back at the command line, so the message wasn’t sent (nothing was typed). Reopen it on the computer and send again.
not_delivered_screen_unreadable: Persona couldn’t read the terminal’s screen on the computer, so it can’t tell whether something is still in the input box. The message wasn’t sent (nothing was typed). Try again shortly.
engine_unavailable: {engine} isn’t running on this computer, or isn’t installed, so nothing was started or sent. To continue a session that’s open on the computer, continue it there; to start one from here, install and open {engine} on this computer first.
engine_start_failed: {engine} isn’t running on this computer and couldn’t be started automatically, so nothing was started or sent. Open {engine} on this computer and try again; the details say why.
engine_resume_unavailable: This session ran in {engine}, and continuing it needs {engine}, which isn’t running on this computer (or isn’t installed). Nothing was sent.
engine_not_enabled: {engine} isn’t turned on for this computer, so no session can start in it. Nothing was sent. Turn it on in Settings › Machines › Engine, or pick another engine.
engine_none: This computer has no terminal engine turned on, so no session can start or continue here. Nothing was sent. Turn one on (herdr, Herdr App, Orca, Paseo, Cindy or T3 Code) in Settings › Machines › this computer › Engine and try again.
engine_unsupported: {engine} on this computer can’t do this. Updating it may help.
orca_unsupported: This Orca chat can’t do that, so nothing was changed.
